title: Probing Preference Representations: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation and Analysis Method for Reward Models
reasoning: The paper introduces and expands a benchmark (MRMBench) that specifically evaluates reward models on 'ethics' and 'fairness' dimensions. It provides quantitative accuracy results for an 'Ethics' dimension—classifying content as 'ethical' vs 'unethical'—and mentions religious-related harmlessness as a potential expansion area for the benchmark.
